## What changed

Explain the problem and the implemented solution.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Legal-data correction
- [ ] Machine-learning change
- [ ] Accessibility or design improvement

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] JSON data validation
- [ ] `node --check static/app.js`
- [ ] Manual browser check, when relevant
- [ ] Mobile layout check, when relevant

## Responsible release checklist

- [ ] I used no real personal or incident data.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behaviour changes.
- [ ] I documented any privacy effect.
- [ ] I included official sources for legal-data changes.
- [ ] I did not describe test count as model accuracy.
- [ ] I added screenshots for visible interface changes.

## Screenshots and sources

Add before/after screenshots and official legal references when applicable.
